url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END) SELECT s.date, s.cognitive_sum, s.cyclomatic_sum FROM complexity_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.folder = f.folder AND s.is_test = 0 ORDER BY s.date","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM coverage_tests ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT suite, tests, files, skipped FROM coverage_tests WHERE sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) UNION ALL SELECT 'total', sum(tests), sum(files), sum(skipped) FROM coverage_tests WHERE sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest)"}

spec.description: Test files, tests and skipped tests of each suite, for the latest commit on main.
spec.title: Tests (latest commit)

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END), latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM complexity_folder_summary WHERE folder = (SELECT folder FROM f) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT substr(s.folder, length(f.folder) + 2) AS child, s.cognitive_sum, s.cyclomatic_sum, s.function_count, s.above_limits FROM complexity_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) AND s.is_test = 0 AND s.folder GLOB f.folder || '/*' AND s.folder NOT GLOB f.folder || '/*/*' ORDER BY s.cognitive_sum DESC","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END), latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM complexity_folder_summary WHERE folder = (SELECT folder FROM f) ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT fn.qualified_name, fn.file, fn.line, fn.cognitive, fn.cyclomatic FROM complexity_functions fn, f WHERE fn.sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) AND fn.is_test = 0 AND fn.file GLOB f.folder || '/*' ORDER BY fn.cognitive DESC, fn.cyclomatic DESC LIMIT 20","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END) SELECT s.date, s.above_limits, s.cognitive_above, s.cyclomatic_above FROM complexity_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.folder = f.folder AND s.is_test = 0 ORDER BY s.date","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END) SELECT s.date, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'merged' THEN s.lines_covered END) / sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'merged' THEN s.lines_total END) AS merged, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'vitest' THEN s.lines_covered END) / sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'vitest' THEN s.lines_total END) AS vitest, 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'e2e' THEN s.lines_covered END) / sum(CASE WHEN s.suite = 'e2e' THEN s.lines_total END) AS e2e FROM coverage_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.folder = f.folder GROUP BY s.date ORDER BY s.date","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END), latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM coverage_folder_summary WHERE folder = (SELECT folder FROM f) AND suite = 'merged' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT substr(s.folder, length(f.folder) + 2) AS child, 100.0 * s.lines_covered / s.lines_total AS lines_pct, 100.0 * s.branches_covered / s.branches_total AS branches_pct, s.lines_total - s.lines_covered AS uncovered_lines, s.file_count FROM coverage_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) AND s.suite = 'merged' AND s.folder GLOB f.folder || '/*' AND s.folder NOT GLOB f.folder || '/*/*' ORDER BY uncovered_lines DESC","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END), latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM coverage_folder_summary WHERE folder = (SELECT folder FROM f) AND suite = 'merged' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT c.file, 100.0 * c.lines_covered / c.lines_total AS lines_pct, c.lines_total - c.lines_covered AS uncovered_lines FROM coverage_files c, f WHERE c.sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) AND c.suite = 'merged' AND c.lines_total >= 20 AND c.file GLOB f.folder || '/*' ORDER BY lines_pct, uncovered_lines DESC LIMIT 20","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"WITH f(folder) AS (SELECT CASE WHEN ?1 = '' OR substr(?1, 1, 1) = '$' THEN 'src' ELSE ?1 END), latest(sha) AS (SELECT sha FROM coverage_folder_summary WHERE folder = (SELECT folder FROM f) AND suite = 'merged' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT s.suite, 100.0 * s.lines_covered / s.lines_total AS lines_pct, 100.0 * s.branches_covered / s.branches_total AS branches_pct FROM coverage_folder_summary s, f WHERE s.sha = (SELECT sha FROM latest) AND s.folder = f.folder","params":["$folder"]}

{"sql":"SELECT date, sum(tests) AS total, sum(CASE WHEN suite = 'unit' THEN tests END) AS unit, sum(CASE WHEN suite = 'integration' THEN tests END) AS integration, sum(CASE WHEN suite = 'e2e' THEN tests END) AS e2e FROM coverage_tests GROUP BY sha, date ORDER BY date"}

spec.description: Runs of the full-ci label and releases, on every operating system.
spec.title: Run time percentiles, full matrix

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH base AS (SELECT replace(CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END, 'test / ', '') AS job, j.os, j.duration_seconds AS v FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND j.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT job, os, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job, os ORDER BY v) AS n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY job, os) AS total FROM base) SELECT job, os, MAX(total) AS runs, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.5 * total THEN v END) AS p50, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.9 * total THEN v END) AS p90, MIN(CASE WHEN n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS p95 FROM ranked GROUP BY job, os ORDER BY p50 DESC"}

{"sql":"WITH base AS (SELECT date(substr(j.date, 1, 10), 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS week, j.os, j.queue_seconds AS v FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND j.queue_seconds IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT week, os, v, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY week, os ORDER BY v) AS n, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY week, os) AS total FROM base) SELECT week AS date, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'linux' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS linux, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'macos' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS macos, MIN(CASE WHEN os = 'windows' AND n >= 0.95 * total THEN v END) AS windows FROM ranked GROUP BY week ORDER BY week"}

spec.description: The wait for a runner, for each operating system.
spec.title: Queue time p95

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH job_runs AS (SELECT replace(CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END, 'test / ', '') AS job, j.os, count(*) AS runs FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2), spent AS (SELECT replace(CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END, 'test / ', '') AS job, j.os, s.name, sum(s.duration_seconds) AS total, max(s.duration_seconds) AS slowest FROM ci_steps s JOIN ci_jobs j ON j.run_id = s.run_id AND j.run_attempt = s.run_attempt AND j.job_id = s.job_id JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = s.run_id AND r.run_attempt = s.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' AND s.duration_seconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT s.job, s.os, s.name, round(1.0 * s.total / n.runs, 1) AS avg_seconds, s.slowest AS slowest_seconds FROM spent s JOIN job_runs n ON n.job = s.job AND n.os = s.os ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC LIMIT 40"}

spec.description: Average seconds in a run of the job. GitHub times a step to the second, and a composite action is one step.
spec.title: Slowest steps

url_options.data: {"sql":"WITH job_runs AS (SELECT replace(CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END, 'test / ', '') AS job, j.os, count(*) AS runs FROM ci_jobs j JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = j.run_id AND r.run_attempt = j.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2), spent AS (SELECT replace(CASE WHEN instr(j.name, ' (') > 0 THEN substr(j.name, 1, instr(j.name, ' (') - 1) ELSE j.name END, 'test / ', '') AS job, j.os, g.name, sum(g.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS total, max(g.duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS slowest FROM ci_step_groups g JOIN ci_jobs j ON j.run_id = g.run_id AND j.run_attempt = g.run_attempt AND j.job_id = g.job_id JOIN ci_runs r ON r.run_id = g.run_id AND r.run_attempt = g.run_attempt WHERE r.workflow = 'Test' AND r.conclusion = 'success' AND r.code_changed = 1 AND j.conclusion = 'success' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT s.job, s.os, s.name, round(s.total / n.runs, 1) AS avg_seconds, round(s.slowest, 1) AS slowest_seconds FROM spent s JOIN job_runs n ON n.job = s.job AND n.os = s.os ORDER BY avg_seconds DESC LIMIT 40"}
